records.title: Beyond Weight Updates: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Domain Specialization
records.claim: Evolving the agent harness while keeping the policy frozen recovers most of the gains of weight updates at a small fraction of the compute.

method_and_setup.method: Harness evolution cast as an RL-style outer loop and instantiated with GEPA.
method_and_setup.setup: Codev, a Claude Code-style coding agent, on SWE-bench Verified, OfficeBench, and Terminal-Bench.

records.change_for_agents: Run a reflective evolutionary optimizer over prompts, tool schemas and skills per domain before considering fine-tuning.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Harness evolution recovers most of the gains of weight updates at a small fraction of the compute; a per-domain harness adapter fits a Claude Code / MCP stack with no GPU.

records.title: How Feedback-Free Self-Evolution Reshapes Agent Skills: A Systematic Study
records.claim: Feedback-free self-rewriting makes skills lose value rather than improve.

method_and_setup.method: Models rewrite expert skills round after round without any task, run or judgment; SkillDiff marks knowledge in place.
method_and_setup.setup: Agents built on the same models run the rewritten skills on SkillsBench and other benchmarks.

results.value: 15 points on average on SkillsBench after thirty rounds
results.measures: Drop in performance with rewritten skills after thirty rounds.
Average pass-rate gain on SkillsBench from SkillDiff.

records.change_for_agents: Protect expert-written skill content from unattended self-rewriting and re-add knowledge outside the model prior.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Do not let an agent auto-rewrite skill files unattended; keep the human-authored parts and mark them.

records.title: DriftGuard: Online Memory-Drift Detection via Causal Attribution for LLM Agents
records.claim: Online memory-drift detection can estimate each retrieved memory's causal contribution to drift at serving time.

method_and_setup.method: Two-stage framework: offline paired counterfactual replays produce a memory drift score; an online risk model estimates it from pre-action information.

records.change_for_agents: Score each retrieved memory for risk before it enters the context for a tool call.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Persistent memory is an attack surface for a day-admin agent; gives a serving-time way to score retrieved memories before the agent acts.

records.title: CompAct-Bench: A Benchmark for Working-Context Compaction in Long-Horizon Agent Tasks
records.claim: Compaction ability of LLMs can be measured through its downstream effect on agent task completion.

method_and_setup.method: Insert compaction boundaries into successful trajectories, compress with the model under test, let the same executor continue.
method_and_setup.setup: Information-seeking, software-engineering and workspace-oriented tasks under controlled retention ratios.

records.change_for_agents: Evaluate compaction prompts by resuming a recorded trajectory and measuring task completion.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Directly relevant to how Claude Code-style compaction should be judged: by downstream task completion, not summary quality.

records.title: MemMend: A Selective Revision Framework for Memory Question Answering
records.claim: Selective, bounded revision improves memory question answering while using fewer revision calls.

method_and_setup.method: Selective revision framework with an editor, bounded exact-text replacements, resolvable source coordinates.
method_and_setup.setup: 1,986 LoCoMo development questions; also applied to PropMem, Mem0 and SimpleMem answers.

results.measures: Conversation-macro F1 on LoCoMo development questions.
Revision calls compared with a verified revision chain.

records.change_for_agents: Gate answer revision behind a router and accept only edits that cite source spans.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: A cheap gate for memory answers: revise only when likely incomplete; the editing interface also improves Mem0 answers.

records.title: HabitusMem: Belief Memory over Evolving User Preferences for LLM Agents
records.claim: Modeling memory as a revisable belief about the user beats content-retrieval memory systems on preference tasks.

method_and_setup.method: A trained writer states beliefs as text records for a frozen agent.
method_and_setup.setup: PersonaMem-v2 and VitaBench 2.0 across two agent families.

records.change_for_agents: Store preferences as beliefs with evidence, scope and status rather than raw history.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Directly on point for a personal agent whose user preferences change; stores whether a preference is still current and where it applies.

records.title: Context as a Resource
records.claim: A routerless context-virtualization architecture avoids cross-topic bleed and lossy handoffs in always-on agents.

method_and_setup.method: ClonAct: Context MMU, in-place Context Cells, Synaptic Bus with isolated trial merge gate, wave-flushed Shared Trunk.
method_and_setup.setup: Three programmatic multi-stream benchmarks and three model families.

records.change_for_agents: Isolate concurrent tasks in separate context cells and merge through a gated trial merge.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Addresses cross-topic bleed in a single always-on personal-agent session and merge conflicts across parallel work.

records.title: How Much Should an Agent Remember? Deployment Lessons from Self-Distilled Memory for LLM Agents
records.claim: The right amount of memory is a property of the model, not the memory.

method_and_setup.method: Pipeline mines lessons from trajectories and consolidates them into guidelines with merge counts.
method_and_setup.setup: AppWorld across models spanning 40-92% baseline task completion.

records.change_for_agents: Select the number of injected guidelines per model instead of always injecting all.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: The right amount of memory depends on the model: strong models keep improving, weaker ones may need selection.

records.title: Seer: Guiding Small Deep-Research Agents with Shared Decision Models
records.claim: Shared learned decision models can guide small deep-research agents at inference time.

method_and_setup.method: Tool-response simulator and value estimator trained offline from real research trajectories and reused across agents.

records.change_for_agents: Use a learned tool-response simulator to pre-score actions instead of executing alternatives.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Fits the local/open-model lane: guidance for small agents without on-device training or extra tool calls.

records.title: Global Importance Estimation for KV Cache Eviction
records.claim: Multi-hop global importance estimation gives a favorable accuracy-memory trade-off for KV eviction.

method_and_setup.method: Training-free KV eviction via Personalized PageRank over attention-induced transition graphs.
method_and_setup.setup: Long-context understanding, sparse retrieval and chain-of-thought tasks across LLM families, compression up to 90%.

records.change_for_agents: Evaluate graph-based KV eviction against recency baselines for long agent sessions.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: KV memory limits local long-context runs on 64 GB unified memory; eviction is a lever for local agent sessions.

records.title: CANDID: Candidate-Driven Intervention for Disciplined Execution in Local Computer-Use Agents
records.claim: Execution-level intervention improves the reliability of local computer-use agents.

method_and_setup.method: Loop-recovery mechanism filtering repeated candidates plus conservative unanimous DONE gating.
method_and_setup.setup: OSWorld with local CUAs.

records.change_for_agents: Filter repeated actions and require consensus before accepting DONE.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Cheap control-layer fixes for local GUI agents that loop or stop early.

records.title: Forget Freely, Grep Later: Lossless, Index-Free Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
records.claim: A lossless append-only log plus regex search can serve as memory for long-horizon agents.

method_and_setup.method: Append-only plain-text log plus a regular-expression search tool; Qwen3.5-9B trained with RL under five context strategies.
method_and_setup.setup: Multi-question research sessions, long-stream recall, agent-trajectory question answering.

records.change_for_agents: Keep an append-only log and expose a regex search tool instead of a vector store.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: A lossless, index-free memory that matches how Claude Code already greps files; trained on Qwen3.5-9B so it fits local models.

records.title: Some Memories Must Fade: Persistence and Decay of User Memories in Model Parameters
records.claim: Parametric memory must retain stable facts, update changed beliefs and let transient information fade.

method_and_setup.method: Fixed-capacity LoRA memory substrate plus a lightweight controller governing each user event.
method_and_setup.setup: A controlled dataset of long-horizon user trajectories with varying fact persistence.

records.change_for_agents: Treat decay and update as first-class operations in a user memory system.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Forgetting and updating belief states for personal memory without a retrieval store; local-adapter angle.

records.title: Evolve Where It Matters: Coverage-Guided Self-Evolution of Agent Skills
records.claim: Coverage-guided self-evolution fixes skills where instructions are wrong or not followed.

method_and_setup.method: SkillPlumber with a persistent root-cause analysis agent and a shared strategy library.
method_and_setup.setup: Three benchmarks and three execution settings.

records.change_for_agents: Label each skill instruction per run before editing the skill.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Separates wrong skill instructions from ignored ones, which matters when maintaining SKILL.md files.

records.title: MATE: Mobile Agent Trustworthy Execution for Safe and Efficient Mobile Control
records.claim: An execution-layer guard makes mobile agents safer and cheaper without modifying the model.

method_and_setup.method: Structured action records, Runtime Guardrail, Predefined Task Routing, floating interface.
method_and_setup.setup: MobileSafetyBench and AndroidWorld.

results.measures: High-risk blocking on MobileSafetyBench under GPT-4o.

records.change_for_agents: Insert an allow/block/ask layer between proposed UI actions and device effects.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Very close to an iOS/mobile day-admin agent: runtime guardrail and verified recurring routes.

records.title: Tether: Verified Stateful Policy Engine for System-Level Monitoring of Agents
records.claim: Stateful policies over observed side-effects can enforce runtime safety for agents.

method_and_setup.method: Sandboxed execution, inferred action semantics, stateful policies in an embedded Lean 4 DSL.

records.change_for_agents: Track data-flow labels across steps and enforce them on observed side-effects.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Stateful policy enforcement catches multi-step data flows that stateless allowlists miss for shell-running agents.

records.title: STARK: Moving towards Personalized Agents That Truly Learn and Remember
records.claim: Event-as-edge dual-graph memory improves long-term personalised memory.

method_and_setup.method: Episodic Graph and Insight Graph with events as edges.
method_and_setup.setup: LongMemEval, LoCoMo and LongLaMP.

records.change_for_agents: Link behavioural insights to the events that support them and retrieve insights directly.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: A memory design that stores why, not just what, for personal agents.

records.title: Characterizing and Detecting Unfaithful Work Reports by Coding Agents
records.claim: Coding agents' work reports often contain unfaithful claims, most commonly overstated task success.

method_and_setup.method: Mixed-methods analysis of real developer-agent conversations.
method_and_setup.setup: SWE-chat conversations and 435 sampled and annotated work reports.

results.measures: Average extra user turns needed to handle an unfaithful report.

records.change_for_agents: Cross-check an agent's work report against tool traces before handing off or accepting.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Overstated success is the most common; agents resuming work trust prior reports, so verify reports before handoff.

records.title: SkillBridge: Cost-Aware Diagnosis and Repair of Cross-OS Compatibility Defects in Agent Skills
records.claim: Contract-based screening finds and repairs OS-sensitive skill defects at lower cost.

method_and_setup.method: Three-stage workflow: static analysis, dynamic validation, repair.
method_and_setup.setup: 3,270 skill-target-OS cases covering 1,090 skills across Linux, macOS and Windows.

results.measures: Reviewer-judged target-task pass rate after repair.

records.change_for_agents: Statically screen skills for OS assumptions before running them on each OS.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Skills written on macOS may fail elsewhere; screening is cheaper than running everything.

records.title: Stop Going in Circles:Loop-Triggered Routing for System 1 Decision Agents
records.claim: Recurring state-action pairs signal stalled execution and can trigger limited LLM assistance.

method_and_setup.method: Action router using loop detection; no additional training.
method_and_setup.setup: ALFWorld, MapReader and TextWorld cooking across three benchmarks and seven LLMs.

results.measures: Mean task-success gains on ALFWorld, MapReader and TextWorld cooking.

records.change_for_agents: Escalate to a stronger model only when state-action repeats are detected.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Loop detection is a cheap trigger for escalating from a small/local model to a larger one.

records.title: EverydayBench: Evaluating Satisfactory Completion of Live User-Facing Digital Work
records.claim: Live user-facing digital work needs outcome-based evaluation with predefined criteria and evidence verification.

method_and_setup.method: Benchmark combining deterministic constraint checks, claim verification and rubric assessment.
method_and_setup.setup: 77 tasks across eight domains; 23 agent-model configurations.

results.measures: Highest strict pass rate across 23 reported configurations.

records.change_for_agents: Score agent deliverables with pre-declared criteria plus verification of cited evidence.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Closest to day-admin style tasks; shows how to score outcomes when multiple answers are valid.

records.title: Backtracking Agent Applications Security Incidents
records.claim: A cross-layer dependency graph bridges the gap between agent trajectory logs and app code for incident backtracking.

method_and_setup.method: Cross-layer dependency graph and query language with region inference.

records.change_for_agents: Keep trajectory logs mappable to function calls so incidents can be traced.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Gives a way to find the compromise entry point after an incident when trajectory logs are all you have.

records.title: Validation-driven Deployment of LLM Inference Platforms for Agentic Workloads
records.claim: Replaying captured traces reproduces the per-session load of original agent sessions.

method_and_setup.method: End-to-end evaluation pipeline for agentic LLM serving.
method_and_setup.setup: vLLM and llm-d rollouts of four large MoE models.

results.measures: Replay stays within this multiple of recorded input tokens at the 95th percentile.
Live re-runs reach this multiple of recorded input tokens.

records.change_for_agents: Replay captured agent sessions to size a self-hosted deployment.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Useful when moving agent workloads to self-hosted open-weight models; replay beats live re-runs for repeatable load.

records.title: Living off the Local Model: Abusing Browser-Embedded Language Models for Post-Exploitation
records.claim: Browser-embedded language models can be abused as post-exploitation engines.

method_and_setup.method: Drive the model from the host using only OS-shipped interpreters.
method_and_setup.setup: Measures credential and PII identification, image classification, custom tool calls, and a simulated end-to-end cyber operation.

records.change_for_agents: Treat OS-embedded local models as an attack surface in threat models.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Local models shipped with the OS/browser are tool-calling surfaces; worth knowing for on-device agent threat models.
